apps.name: Nijatva Gallery
apps.shortDescription: Local-first gallery: folders as albums, photos and videos in one grid, EXIF stripped on share.
apps.description: Local-first Android gallery. Folders become albums, photos and videos share one grid, and EXIF metadata is stripped when you share. Kotlin, no Compose, no Google Play Services, no accounts, no ads, no analytics.
apps.changelog:
- Appearance sheet fixed: the fourth theme pill no longer wraps into a circle
- Theme pills now use FlowRow so large font scales do not break the row

apps.name: Nijatva Browser
apps.shortDescription: Privacy-first browser on the system WebView: containers, tracker and ad blocking, reader mode, native TTS.
apps.description: A privacy-first Android browser built on the system WebView. Containers keep sessions apart, tracker and ad blocking run locally, reader mode strips clutter, and text to speech is native. No Google Play Services, no accounts, no analytics.
apps.changelog:
- Debug-signed build published as a release asset
- Desktop builds for Windows, macOS and Linux ship from the same tag

apps.name: Nijatva Camera
apps.shortDescription: Camera2 app with manual controls, RAW capture, night stacking, exposure fusion, panorama and portrait blur.
apps.description: A Camera2 camera app: manual controls for focus, shutter and ISO, RAW capture, night stacking, exposure fusion, panorama stitching and portrait blur. Package com.nijatva.camera, targetSdk 35.
apps.changelog:
- v0.4.10 preview-match debug build
- Note: the APK inside the tag still reports versionName 0.4.0 (versionCode 4)

apps.name: Nijatva Dialer
apps.shortDescription: Private, offline phone app: calls, call log and SMS, no ads and no trackers.
apps.description: A private, offline phone app that covers calling, the call log, contacts and SMS in one place. No ads, no trackers, and no internet permission in the APK.

apps.name: Nijatva Contacts
apps.shortDescription: Offline contacts app with groups, favourites, VCF import and export, and optional Zoho sync.
apps.description: An offline contacts app with groups, favourites, VCF import and export, and an optional Zoho sync. The APK requests the internet permission only for that optional sync.

apps.name: Nijatva Messages
apps.shortDescription: Private SMS app with smart categories, OTP detection, search and a dark interface.
apps.description: A private SMS app with smart categories, OTP detection, search and a dark interface. No internet permission in the APK.

apps.name: Nijatva Music
apps.shortDescription: Offline audio player built with Compose Multiplatform; Android APK plus desktop and web builds.
apps.description: Offline audio player written once with Compose Multiplatform and shipped for Android, Windows, macOS, Linux and the web. Plays local files; no account needed.
apps.changelog:
- 1.1.2 debug-signed APK built from commit b963e30
- Grant the audio permission on first launch to scan local files

apps.name: Nijatva File
apps.shortDescription: Offline file manager in plain Java: list/grid/waterfall, built-in player, text editor, PDF viewer, ZIP.
apps.description: A fast, offline file manager written in plain Java with no AndroidX and no Kotlin. My Files home with category tiles, list, grid and waterfall browsing, a built-in image, video and music player, text editor with TTS, PDF viewer, ZIP handling, Smart Clean, app manager and recycle bin.
apps.changelog: No APK is published for this repository yet, so the store lists it as not published.

apps.name: Nijatva Editor
apps.shortDescription: Fully offline photo editor, Kotlin and Compose, pure AMOLED black, no internet permission.
apps.description: Fully offline photo editor for Android, Kotlin + Jetpack Compose + Material 3 on a pure #000000 AMOLED surface. No internet permission, no analytics, no cloud, so every edit stays on the device.
apps.changelog:
- v1.5.0 release build with a signed APK
- Fully offline: no internet permission

apps.name: Nijatva Appstore
apps.shortDescription: The store itself: hosted catalogue, updates and installs.
apps.description: The store that lists the Nijatva suite. Reads a hosted catalogue, keeps the last copy on disk for offline use, verifies every APK against a SHA-256 before installing, and reports the installer's own reason when a package is refused.
apps.changelog:
- Catalogue now comes from GitHub instead of being baked into the APK
- Offline: last fetched catalogue is kept on disk

apps.name: NewPipe
apps.shortDescription: Free YouTube and SoundCloud front end: no ads, no login, background playback.
apps.description: NewPipe is a libre streaming front end for Android. It plays YouTube and SoundCloud without a Google account, supports background audio, downloads and on-device subscriptions.

apps.name: F-Droid
apps.shortDescription: The free-software catalogue: browse and install FOSS apps from signed repositories.
apps.description: F-Droid is a catalogue of free and open-source Android apps. It verifies each repository's signed index, lists anti-features and permissions, and installs only what the repository signs.

apps.name: KeePassDX
apps.shortDescription: Offline KeePass password manager with autofill and biometric unlock.
apps.description: KeePassDX reads and writes KeePass databases on the device. Autofill, biometric unlock and its own keyboard are included; no cloud, no account.
